answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a licensed acoustic census post in a named tundra meadow, where the holder records the dawn chorus echo each morning and files it in a public log. Random live checks demand the holder play that morning's echo back from the post within minutes, and one operator cannot staff two posts at once. The permit fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another real meadow post, another season of dawn recordings, another human, and twice the prior fee.
